# Sample data – 100% synthetic

**None of this is real telemetry.** It was produced by [`scripts/generate_sample_data.py`](../scripts/generate_sample_data.py) and can be regenerated byte-for-byte (a test enforces this).

- Domain: `contoso.example` (reserved by RFC 2606 – can never belong to a real organisation).
- IPs: only RFC 5737 documentation ranges (`192.0.2.0/24`, `198.51.100.0/24`, `203.0.113.0/24`).
- Command-line payload: base64 of a harmless `Write-Output` string.
- A test fails the build if any non-reserved domain or non-documentation IP appears.

| File | Shaped like table | Rows | Used by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `signinlogs_sample.csv` | `SigninLogs` (subset of columns) | see file | detections 01, 02 |
| `auditlogs_sample.jsonl` | `AuditLogs` (nested JSON for `InitiatedBy`, `TargetResources`) | 4 | detection 03 |
| `deviceprocessevents_sample.csv` | `DeviceProcessEvents` (subset) | 4 | detection 04 |
| `azureactivity_sample.csv` | `AzureActivity` (subset) | 4 | detections 05, 06 |
| `resource_inventory.json` | simplified ARM-style resource list | 4 | SC-500 lab 01 simulator |

**Limitations:** columns are a subset of the real schemas; real logs contain many more fields and much more noise. Do not infer production thresholds from this data.
